description: Ghani Chemical Industries Limited is a manufacturer of medical and industrial gases, which describes itself as Pakistan's largest such producer. It inherited the business of Ghani Gases (Private) Limited, incorporated in November 2007 and converted to a public company in 2008; under a scheme sanctioned by the Lahore High Court in 2019 that company's manufacturing undertaking was transferred to Ghani Chemical Industries, which is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. The company's product range runs from oxygen, nitrogen and argon to medical gases, gas-handling equipment and welding consumables.
